head: codex/5817-v092-wp01
title: [v0.92][WP-01][planning] Promote canonical docs and open the final issue wave
body:
Closes #5817

## Summary
- activates the canonical v0.92 milestone package and complete issue wave
- initializes 41 child and supporting issues plus five coordination-only sprint umbrellas with typed C-SDLC v2 records
- consolidates temporary publication ownership under WP-01 so every PR path is protected
- requires every real child session to register its worktree and reacquire its exact issue-local claim after WP-01 releases
- reconciles all 47 live issue contracts with the canonical wave, including WP-02/WP-02A and WP-14 integration gates

## Validation
- live typed csdlc-github capture: PASS, 47/47 issues open and retained against the current wave digest
- ruby .csdlc/prepared/issues/5817/validate-v092-package.rb: PASS, 39 WPs, 41 child issues, five sprint umbrellas, 552 card artifacts
- parent publication claim audit: PASS, every changed path covered and all 46 child/supporting/sprint bootstrap claims released
- Ruby syntax checks for the validator and live-contract capture: PASS
- csdlc-doctor --repo . --issue 5817: PASS
- git diff --check: PASS

## Review
- the external exact-head review findings were corrected: two P1s and one P2 resolved
- Gemini 3.1 Pro reviewed exact substantive commit 125a40124: APPROVE, zero new or outstanding defects
- the later commit contains typed review metadata only

## Non-Claims
- WP-01 prepares and publishes planning, issue, card, sprint, and session-start surfaces only
- child implementation has not started through this issue
- Runtime reasoning tests were not rerun for this docs/control-plane remediation; the earlier 13/13 result remains historical prerequisite evidence
- every child retains its own implementation, proof, review, PR, and terminal authority
